results.title: News Flash • Pender County, NC
results.content: ### Pender County Parks and Recreation kicks off 2026 Summer Concert Series this week. Pender County Parks and Recreation will kick off the 2026 Alive After Five summer concert series this Friday, May 15, at Hampstead Kiwanis Park. The free concert will take place from 6:30 to 8:30 p.m. and feature live music from Carl Newton’s Review. “We are pleased to present this year’s concert lineup and provide an opportunity for residents and visitors to enjoy live music and food from local vendors,” said Zachary White, director of Pender County Parks and Recreation. Pender County broke ground Wednesday, May 6, at the new Hampstead Branch Library, marking a major step forward for library services in one of the county’s fastest-growing areas. Judy Holly Sidbury was a founding member of the Pender County Friends of the Library and a longtime supporter of library services in the community. Randy Burton, chairman of the Pender County Board of Commissioners, spoke about the county’s continued investment in projects that serve residents and strengthen the community.
